purpose: Mechanical authorization-boundary inventory of every hosted API route family (rc11 internal security review F-04, owner addendum §E GATE 2). Verified by sdk/test/authorization-boundary-inventory.test.js: every route family literal in server/src/scopes.js and server/src/api.js must appear here; machine scopes must match requiredScopesFor; every non-public route must name an auth gate present in its file; every tenant-owned route must name a tenancy resolver and (for mutations) a mutation gate, plus a hostile-evidence test that exercises its path with a foreign principal; `void principal`-style discards are lint failures unless listed under documentedExceptions.

principalTypes.optional: principal resolved when presented; route serves no tenant-owned object
principalTypes.session-or-machine: wallet session cookie / bearer session or a pvmk_ machine credential (deny-by-default scopes)

resourceClasses.global: authenticated aggregate or chain fact; not a tenant-owned object
resourceClasses.identity: machine identities of the creating wallet
resourceClasses.org-root: on-chain organizational root records and their requests
resourceClasses.creator-owned: records owned by the creating principal (webhooks, notification rules, events)
